verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a per-endpoint API reference (search, extract, crawl, map, research, usage, logs) with copy-paste code examples. Keyless SDK mode lets the search and extract examples run without an API key, and every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. However, no evidence shows an in-browser interactive playground or "try it" console, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: documented interactive in-browser request console or playground, a published OpenAPI spec, runnable examples for crawl/map/research without a key, and independent corroboration of the interactive experience.
